title: Exercise Savage Jackal: 57 RQS strengthens combat readiness through maritime recovery operations
description: U.S. Air Force pararescuemen assigned to the 57th Rescue Squadron based out of Aviano Air Base, Italy, conduct maritime hoist insertion procedures to recover a simulated isolated person during Exercise Savage Jackal in San Diego, California, July 19, 2026. Open-water rescue scenarios test the squadron's capability to locate, stabilize and extract isolated personnel under extreme oceanic conditions. (U.S. Air Force video by Airman 1st Class Antone Williams)
credit: U.S. Air Force video by Airman 1st Class Antone Williams
pass_reason: training: Osprey is a distant speck over calm sea, hoist never readable
